subject: Processing epoch level data from UK biobank

messages.author: 8606a03db85d3fd7
messages.subject: Processing epoch level data from UK biobank
parts:
Hello there, 

I am trying to process accelerometer data from the UK Biobank to extract sleep measures. I know I can use the raw data in .cwa format to extract such measures. I read in the GGIR manual that epoch level data in .csv format can also be used as input. However,  the example provided is limited to steps 1 and 2. 

Is it possible to extract sleep measures also from these csv files? 

Best regards, 

Sofia

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: Processing epoch level data from UK biobank
parts:
Hi Sofia, 

The majority of the algorithms (someone correct me if it's changed recently) rely on knowing one individual axis at the raw level (see https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#56_Sleep_analysis)
The .csv files from UKB do not provide you with this as they only provide ENMO therefore you can't run parts 3:5 in GGIR to derive your own sleep metrics.

Thanks,
Ben

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Processing epoch level data from UK biobank
parts:
Sofia,

The UKBiobank csv data can only be used for GGIR parts 1 and 2, because it does not include the essential additional variables needed for sleep detection.

Ben - GGIR needs data from all 3 raw acceleration axes for all metrics, except the zero crossing count which only require a signal axis. So also for z-angle GGIR uses all 3 axes.

Best,

Vincent
